log.msg: Why System design read empty: its 7 sub-cards are topic stubs written by hand, line 1 is only {"title", "icon"} (no class, no id, no created, nothing asked). Servex's card list does not know them, so the row title fell back to the slug; nothing in them can ever be delivered, so they all read as to do. And with no id line the sub-card's own id was undefined, so its chat and composer had no card to talk into (re: undefined): the blank chat on agents-and-roles.

decision.question: How is a sub-card nothing was asked in counted?
options: As a request still to do
As a topic: listed, not counted
decision.why: Seven concept stubs read as seven undone asks, which is false. A sub-card becomes a request the moment it has a prompt, a message, an item, a status or an ask type.
